verses.en: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,
verses.sm: avau. Tata. O igoa o zoa sa ia te za O toe upu nei a Tavita; na fai ane Tavita le atalii o lese, ua fai ane le tagata ua faaeaina, o le ua faauuina e le Atua o lakopo, o le faipese malie o Isaraelu.

verses.en: The Spirit of the LORD spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.
verses.sm: O aʻu na fetalai ane ai le Agaga o le ALII; o lana afioga foi sa i loʻu laulaufaiva.

verses.en: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.
verses.sm: Na fetalai mai ia te au le Atua o Isaraelu; o le papa o Isaraelu, ua fetalai mai o ia, O le ua pule i tagata ia faia ma le tonu; ia pule ma le mataʻu i le Atua;

verses.en: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
verses.sm: e pei o le malamalama o le taeao ina ua alu ae le la, o le taeao e leai ni ao uli; e pei o le vao mu'a mai le eleele i le pupula mai mai le timuga.

verses.en: Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.
verses.sm: E ui lava ina le faapea loʻu aiga ma le Atua, a ua na osi se feagaiga e faavavau ma aʻu, o loo saunia i mea uma lava, ma ua tausia ; aua e ui lava ona le faauluolaina e ia, ona gata lea o lo'u olataga, ona gata foi lea o lo'u manao.

verses.en: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:
verses.sm: A o e ulavavale, e pei o laau tuitui, ua lafoaiina i latou uma lava; auā e le tagofia i latou e lima.

verses.en: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.
verses.sm: A o le tagata na te tago i ai, e ao ina i ai ia te ia se uamea ma le fuata o le tao; e matuā susunuina i latou i le afi i lea lava mea.

verses.en: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.
verses.sm: O igoa nei o toa sa ia Tavita; o lē nofo i le nofoa o le Takamoni, e sili o ia i le toatolu, o Atino lea le Asoni; na sii lona tao i le toavalu galau na fasiotia i le aso e tasi.

verses.en: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:
verses.sm: E aupito ane i ai o Eleasaro le atalii o Toto, le atalii o Aoki, sa i le au toa e toatolu faatasi ma Tavita, ina ua latou faifai ia Filisitia sa faapotopotoina i lea mea i le taua, a ua O ae tagata o Isaraelu;

verses.en: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.
verses.sm: O ia lava na tu ma fasi ia Filisitia, ua 00 ina ua gase lona lima, ma ua pipii lona lima ma le pelu; ua faia lava e le ALII le faaolataga tele i lea aso; ua foi atu le nuu o mulimuli ia te ia na ona vete.

verses.en: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.sm: E aupito ane ia te ia o Sama le atalii o Aka le Arari; sa faapotopoto Filisitia i le “au, sa i ai le fasi fanua ua lilo i atasema; na sosola ai le nuu i luma o Filisitia.

verses.en: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.
verses.sm: Na tu o ia i totonu o le fanua, ma na faasaoina ai, ma na fasi ia Filisitia; ua faia foi e le ALII le faaolataga tele.

verses.en: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.sm: Na o ifo foi le toatolu mai le toatolugafulu o e ua sili, ua oo atu i ona po o le seleselegāsaito ia Tavita i le ana i Atulama; a ua to lauapi le ʻau a Filisitia i le vanu o sa Rafā.

verses.en: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.
verses.sm: O ona po ia sa nofo 'olo ai Tavita; a o le leoleoga o Filisitia sa i Peteleema ia.

verses.en: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate!
verses.sm: Ona manao ai lea o Tavita, ua faapea, Ta fia inu vai o le vaieli i Peteleema o loo i le faitotoa!

verses.en: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona sofaia lea e nei toa e toatolu i le togālauapi a Filisitia, ma latou utu vai mai le vaieli i Peteleema ua i le faitotoa; ua avae ai, ma au mai ia Tavita, a ua le mafai o ia ona inu ai, a ua liligi atu i le ALII;

verses.en: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
verses.sm: ua fai ane o ia, Le ALII e, ia mamao ia te au ona faia o lenei mea; e le o le toto ea lenei o nei tagata, na latou o toai i ai? e le mafai ia te ia ona inu ai. O mea ia na faia e nei toa e toatolu.

verses.en: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them, and had the name among three.
verses.sm: O Apisai foi le uso o Ioapo, le tama a Seruia, o ia na sili i le toatolu; o ia foi na sii lona tao i le toatolu galau na fasia e ia; sa ta‘ua o ia faatasi ma le toatolu.

verses.en: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.
verses.sm: E le na sili ea ona yua o ia i le toatolu? sa fai ma alii o ia ia te i latou, a ua le aulia le muai toatolu.

verses.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:
verses.sm: O Penaia foi le atalii o Ioiata, le atalii o le tagata malosi mai Kapeseelu, na faia mea tetele; o ia na fasi i tagata o Moapi e faamataleona e toalua; o ia foi na alu ifo, ma fasi le leona i totonu o le lua i ona po o kiona.

verses.en: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.sm: O ia foi na fasi le tagata Aikupito, o le tagata aulelei; sa i le lima o le Aikupito le tao, na ia alu ifo ia te ia ma le tootoo, ma na seia le tao ai le lima o le Aikupito, ma fasioti ia te ia i lona lava tao.

verses.en: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.
verses.sm: O mea nei na faia e Penaia le atalii o Ioiata, sa ta‘ua foi o ia faatasi ma toa e toatolu;

verses.en: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.
verses.sm: e sili ona viia o ia i le toatolu sefulu, a e lei aulia le muai toatolu; na tofia o ia e Tavita e pule i e na faafeao ia te ia.

verses.en: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,
verses.sm: O Asaelu le uso o Ioapo, o so le toatolu sefulu o ia; o Eleana le atalii o Toto le Peteleema,

verses.en: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
verses.sm: o Sama le Haroti, o Elika le Haroti,

verses.en: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
verses.sm: o Helesa le Paleti, o Ira le atalii o Ikesa le Tikoa,

verses.en: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
verses.sm: o Apieseru le Anatota, o Mepuna o lo le fanau a Usa,

verses.en: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
verses.sm: o Salemoni le sa Aoki, o Maarai le sa Netopa,

verses.en: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
verses.sm: o Helepa le atalii o Paana le sa Netopa, o Itai le atalii o Ripai le Kipea o le aai o le fanauga a Peniamina,

verses.en: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,
verses.sm: o Penaia le Piratonu, o Hitai mai vaitafe o Kaasa,

verses.en: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
verses.sm: 0 Api-elepona le Arepa, o Asemau le Paíuma,

verses.en: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
verses.sm: o Eliepa le Saalepo, o le tasi atalii o lasanu, o Ionatana,

verses.en: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,
verses.sm: o Sama le Harari, o Aiamu le atalii o Saru le Arari,

verses.en: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
verses.sm: O Elipelete le atalii o Asepai, le atalii o le Maakati, o Eliamu le atalii o Aitofele le Kilo,

verses.en: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
verses.sm: o Heserai le Karamelu, o Pagarai le Arapa,

verses.en: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
verses.sm: o Ikalo le atalii o Natano mai Sopa, o Pani le Kato,

verses.en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.sm: O Seleka le Amoni, o Naarai le Perota le soátau o Ioapo le tama a Seruia,

verses.en: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,
verses.sm: o Ira le sa leteró, o Karepa le sa Ieterò,

verses.en: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.
verses.sm: o Uria le sa Heti; o ona atoatoa e toatolugafulu ma le toafitu.
